issues.description: Wrong page is being shown. The expected screen is step-3 (style quiz with comparison pairs / room image selection), but the auth page is being displayed instead. The URL confirms redirect to /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-3, meaning the user is not authenticated and is being redirected to auth before reaching step-3.
issues.element: Entire page content - showing auth instead of style quiz
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-3 route has authentication middleware or a guard that redirects unauthenticated users to /auth. The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts (or similar) is intercepting the request and redirecting to /auth with next=/design/step-3. This is expected auth behavior, but from a QA perspective the test session is not authenticated, so step-3 cannot be reached.

issues.description: Console logs show 'page:mount' event firing twice for the auth page on each load (duplicate mount events), indicating a possible StrictMode double-mount or a component re-mounting unexpectedly.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx, the analytics/logging useEffect or page:mount event is likely firing inside a useEffect without proper cleanup, or the component is wrapped in React.StrictMode causing double invocation in development.
